$schema_note: spec v5 feature matrix. Ids are exact ids from trae77/client-site-templates (tools/library.mjs FEATURES, tools/money.mjs MONEY/MONEY_DEFAULTS, tools/mockup.mjs TRADE_ALIASES) and trae77/multipage-template (presets/industries.json actions, site.config.json features). Read 2026-10-19.

failOn: unknown trade with any money/feature beyond fallback.allowed
warnOn: any id not in this trade's allowed or forbidden lists
money default overridden by an allowed non-default value
data file present for a forbidden feature (e.g. menu in content/sample.json on non-food trade)
rules.override: --allow-feature <id> with --reason TEXT downgrades one fail to a warning and is logged in the build output

hvac.label: heating & cooling
hvac.note: booking allowed only as maintenance-visit scheduling add-on

pest-control.label: pest control
pest-control.note: schema @type LocalBusiness (PestControl is not a schema.org type)

dental-medical.label: dental & medical
dental-medical.note: button label "Request a Visit"; portal off; no health details in forms

law-accounting.label: law & accounting
law-accounting.note: consultation request; multipage uses book, client-site-templates uses quote-form — both allowed

church.label: church
church.note: no money feature; schedule = service times

restaurant.label: restaurant & food truck
restaurant.note: pickup-order needs --menu-file; without it build falls back to menu + call (NOT quote-form)

fallback._applies_to: any trade id not in trades (including unknown aliases resolved to generic-business by --trade typo)
fallback.label: unknown trade

auditMarkers._note: Not part of the spec v5 matrix: HTML patterns used by npm run audit:industry. A marker is a leak when none of its ids is allowed (money.allowed or features.allowed) for the page trade.
